label: Diagram 16
caption: Diagram 16 Example notice plate for hearths and flues
description:
This drawing is a tabular diagram, not a plan or section, showing a sample label. A pale green header band across the top reads "Diagram 16 Example notice plate for hearths and flues", with "Example notice plate for hearths and flues" in bold.

The sheet has two columns. The narrow left column carries two bold italic headings, "Essential information" at the top and "Optional additional information" at the bottom. The wider right column is a bordered box containing the plate text.

Inside the box, a bold heading reads "IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION", followed by the bold line "This label must not be removed or covered". Below are lines of prompt text with dotted fill-in lines, each matched to an example entry on the right: "Property address" with "20 Main Street New Town"; "The hearth and chimney installed in the" with "lounge", and on the line below "are suitable for" with "decorative fuel effect gas fire"; "Chimney liner" with "double skin stainless steel flexible, 200mm diameter"; "Suitable for condensing appliance" with "no", and on the line below "Installed on" with "date". A horizontal rule separates these from the optional section, where "Other information (optional)" is matched on the right to "Designation of stainless steel liner stated by manufacturer to be 7450 N2 S D 3", while the left cell also carries an italic note listing examples, e.g. installer's name, product trade names, installation and maintenance advice, European chimney product designations, and warnings on performance limitations of imitation elements, e.g. false hearths.
